title: Senior Full Stack Developer (React + Node.js)
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Full Stack Developer (React + Node.js) based in Turkey. Are you a seasoned full stack developer passionate about building scalable applications and solving complex engineering challenges? This opportunity allows you to contribute to innovative digital solutions transforming how utility companies plan, manage, and optimize their field operations. You will work on a cloud-native platform combining workflow automation, operational management, digital twin technology, and AI-powered planning capabilities. Using React, Node.js, NestJS, PostgreSQL, and AWS, you will develop end-to-end features that deliver tangible value to real-world infrastructure operations. You will take ownership of features from initial design through production deployment while contributing to architectural decisions and platform reliability. Working remotely with experienced engineers and an international team, including UK-based stakeholders, you will have the opportunity to influence product development and adopt modern AI-assisted engineering practices. Accountabilities Develop modern frontend applications: Design, build, and maintain responsive, scalable, and user-friendly React applications that support operational planning, scheduling, and management workflows. Build robust backend services: Develop and maintain scalable backend services and REST APIs using Node.js and NestJS, ensuring performance, security, and maintainability. Deliver end-to-end features: Take ownership of full stack functionality from requirements analysis and technical design through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing maintenance. Design and optimize databases: Develop and maintain PostgreSQL schemas, optimize queries, and ensure efficient data management and reliable application performance. Implement cloud-native solutions: Deploy, operate, and support applications on AWS, leveraging relevant services and infrastructure to build scalable and resilient systems. Contribute to technical architecture: Participate in architectural discussions, recommend effective technical solutions, review code, and help establish engineering standards and best practices. Maintain software quality: Implement appropriate testing strategies, participate in code reviews, support release activities, and contribute to continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) processes. Troubleshoot and improve reliability: Investigate production incidents, identify root causes, resolve technical issues, and proactively improve platform stability, performance, and scalability. Collaborate with cross-functional teams: Work closely with product managers, designers, engineers, and UK-based stakeholders to translate business requirements into practical technical solutions. Drive independent problem-solving: Analyze complex technical challenges, evaluate alternatives, and deliver solutions with minimal supervision. Leverage AI-assisted development: Use modern development tools, including Cursor and Claude Code, to accelerate implementation, improve productivity, and support efficient software engineering workflows. Requirements Professional experience: At least 7 years of commercial Node.js development experience, with a strong focus on backend engineering and building production-grade applications. Frontend expertise: Solid commercial experience with React and the ability to develop and maintain modern, scalable frontend applications. Backend development: Strong knowledge of Node.js, hands-on experience with NestJS, and demonstrated expertise in designing, implementing, and maintaining REST APIs and backend services. Database proficiency: Strong knowledge of PostgreSQL, including database design, query optimization, and efficient data access patterns. Cloud computing: Practical experience with AWS services, particularly Lambda, ECS, API Gateway, and related cloud infrastructure. Software engineering practices: Good understanding of software testing, Git workflows, code reviews, CI/CD pipelines, and modern development methodologies. Analytical and problem-solving skills: Ability to investigate complex technical issues, identify root causes, make sound engineering decisions, and deliver effective solutions independently. Communication skills: Upper-intermediate English proficiency (B2+) or higher, with the ability to collaborate effectively with international colleagues and communicate daily with a UK-based team. Adaptability and ownership: A proactive approach to development, strong attention to detail, and the ability to take responsibility for features throughout the software development lifecycle. Nice To Have Strong commercial experience with TypeScript. Experience with Docker and containerization technologies. Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform or AWS CloudFormation. Experience building SaaS platforms or highly available production systems. Familiarity with monitoring, observability, and cloud security best practices. Experience with Feathers.js. Experience with automated testing tools such as Playwright or Selenium. Experience integrating third-party services and platforms, including Stripe, OpenSearch, or Elasticsearch. Experience working in large, cross-functional engineering teams. Familiarity with Java Spring applications. Experience using AI-powered development tools to enhance engineering productivity. Benefits Competitive compensation: A salary package that reflects your skills, experience, and technical expertise. The specific salary range is not disclosed in the original job posting. Remote work: Work remotely in an international environment, with the flexibility and convenience of a distributed team. Contract opportunity: An initial engagement of approximately 6–12 months, with potential longer-term project prospects. Meaningful industry impact: Contribute to digital products that help utility companies improve operational planning, field service management, and infrastructure efficiency. Modern technology stack: Work with React, Node.js, NestJS, PostgreSQL, AWS, and other contemporary technologies in a cloud-native environment. AI-powered development: Gain exposure to AI-assisted coding tools and modern engineering practices that support productivity and innovation. Technical ownership: Take responsibility for end-to-end features, contribute to architectural decisions, and help improve the performance and reliability of production systems. title: Java Tech Lead / Solution Architect (React , Telecom)
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Java Tech Lead / Solution Architect (React, Telecom) based in Turkey. Are you an experienced Java engineer ready to combine hands-on development, solution architecture, and technical leadership on a strategic telecommunications project? In this remote opportunity, you will help build a modern customer and administration portal alongside an integration platform designed to transform legacy business processes. You will lead the initial technical discovery, define the architectural foundations, and guide the delivery of a production-ready minimum viable product (MVP). Working at the intersection of Java, Spring Boot, React, and cloud-native technologies, you will balance architecture and technical leadership with hands-on coding. You will mentor a team of three full-stack developers while collaborating directly with international stakeholders and technical partners. This role offers the opportunity to influence key engineering decisions and contribute to a scalable telecommunications platform with potential long-term prospects. Accountabilities Own solution architecture: Define and maintain the technical architecture for the customer portal and integration platform within the telecommunications Business Support Systems/Operations Support Systems (BSS/OSS) domain. Lead technical discovery: Assess requirements, evaluate technical options, identify dependencies, and establish the implementation strategy and architectural foundations for the MVP. Design scalable systems: Develop domain models, REST APIs, integration flows, microservices, and event-driven components using sound architectural principles, including Domain-Driven Design (DDD). Contribute hands-on development: Write and maintain production-quality Java and Spring Boot code, focusing particularly on complex technical components and critical integration scenarios. Maintain an approximate 50/50 balance between architecture and technical leadership on one side and hands-on development on the other. Lead and mentor developers: Guide a team of three full-stack Java developers through technical planning, implementation, problem-solving, and delivery, fostering collaboration and continuous improvement. Establish engineering standards: Conduct code reviews, define coding conventions, implement quality gates, and promote maintainable, reliable, and secure software development practices. Guide frontend architecture: Shape the React and TypeScript application architecture, establish UI development standards, review frontend code, and contribute to implementation when needed. Design enterprise integrations: Build integration strategies for external services, third-party APIs, and legacy systems, applying reliable patterns such as idempotency, retries, asynchronous processing, and the Transactional Outbox pattern. Drive security and workflow design: Guide authentication, authorization, and access-control implementations using OAuth2, OpenID Connect (OIDC), Spring Security, and role-based access control (RBAC), alongside appropriate workflow orchestration solutions. Collaborate across engineering teams: Work closely with DevOps and QA specialists on AWS environments, CI/CD pipelines, contract testing, deployment practices, and integration quality. Document and communicate decisions: Record architectural decisions using Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) and C4 diagrams, communicate directly with UK-based stakeholders and third-party technical teams, and demonstrate progress through regular live demos. Support modern engineering practices: Incorporate AI-assisted development tools and contemporary software delivery methods to improve productivity and engineering effectiveness. Requirements Professional experience: At least 8 years of commercial Java development experience and 2 or more years in a Tech Lead, Solution Architect, or comparable technical leadership position. Telecommunications expertise: Practical experience in the telecommunications sector, preferably involving internet service providers (ISPs), BSS/OSS platforms, broadband services, order management, product catalogues, or service qualification. Java and backend development: Strong hands-on experience with Java and Spring Boot, including the design and implementation of production-grade backend services and complex integrations. Frontend development: At least 3–4 years of practical experience with React/ReactJS and TypeScript, including the ability to guide frontend architecture, review code, and contribute to development when required. Solution architecture: Demonstrated experience designing and delivering microservices-based, integration-heavy systems, with a strong understanding of DDD, event-driven architecture, distributed systems, and scalable application design. API and integration design: Experience designing REST APIs and OpenAPI-based contracts, integrating multiple external systems, and implementing reliable communication patterns such as retries, idempotency, asynchronous processing, and transactional messaging. Telecom standards: Familiarity with TM Forum Open APIs is required, ideally supported by practical experience in telecommunications integration projects. Workflow orchestration: Hands-on experience with Camunda, Flowable, or a comparable workflow or business-process orchestration engine. Security expertise: Practical knowledge of OAuth2, OIDC, Spring Security, and RBAC, including the implementation of secure authentication and authorization mechanisms. Cloud and DevOps: Experience with AWS and containerized environments, including Docker and Kubernetes, with exposure to services such as Amazon EKS or ECS and modern CI/CD practices. Technical leadership: Proven ability to mentor developers, coordinate technical planning, conduct effective code reviews, make architectural decisions, and guide a team toward successful delivery. Communication skills: Upper-intermediate (B2+) to advanced (C1) English proficiency, with the ability to communicate technical concepts clearly and collaborate directly with UK-based clients and international teams. AI-assisted development: Familiarity with AI-powered coding tools such as Claude Code or Cursor and an interest in applying them effectively within professional software engineering workflows. Nice To Have Experience with PostgreSQL and database migration tools such as Flyway or Liquibase. Familiarity with Apache Kafka or AWS SQS for messaging and event-driven communication. Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform or AWS CDK. Understanding of multi-tenant application architectures. Practical experience with Auth0. Familiarity with telecommunications and network systems such as RADIUS, NetBox, or IP Address Management (IPAM). Knowledge of UK broadband ecosystems and providers such as Openreach, PXC, or CityFibre. Experience leading technical discovery phases, architecture spikes, or early-stage platform design initiatives. Benefits Competitive compensation: A salary package that reflects your technical expertise, professional experience, and qualifications. The specific salary range is not disclosed in the original posting. Remote work: Work remotely, with the flexibility and convenience of a distributed working environment. Strategic project involvement: Join a strategically important pilot team responsible for delivering the first production phase of a new telecommunications platform. Potential long-term opportunities: An initial contract of approximately four months or more, with potential longer-term project prospects. Modern technology stack: Work with Java, Spring Boot, React, TypeScript, microservices, event-driven architecture, AWS, Docker, and Kubernetes. AI-powered development exposure: Explore AI-assisted engineering practices and tools within an enterprise-scale software development environment. Technical ownership: Influence architectural decisions, establish engineering standards, and contribute directly to the design and implementation of a new platform. Collaborative culture: Work in an open environment where technical expertise, innovative ideas, and proactive problem-solving are valued. title: Senior PHP/Laravel Developer with Infrastructure & DevOps Experience
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior PHP/Laravel Developer with Infrastructure & DevOps Experience based in Turkey. We are seeking an experienced technical professional who combines strong software engineering expertise with hands-on infrastructure and DevOps capabilities. In this role, you will build, maintain, and modernize business-critical, data-driven applications while ensuring the reliability of the systems that support them. You will spend approximately 70% of your time on software development and application support, with the remaining 30% dedicated to infrastructure administration and DevOps. You will work across the full application lifecycle, from architecture and development to deployment, monitoring, and incident resolution. Your contributions will help improve system performance, security, maintainability, and operational resilience. This opportunity is ideal for a senior developer who enjoys solving complex technical challenges, taking ownership of production systems, and continuously improving both applications and infrastructure in a remote working environment. Accountabilities Application Development and Maintenance: Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain business-critical applications using PHP, Laravel, Filament, and PostgreSQL. Modernize legacy systems, reduce technical debt, and improve application performance, reliability, and maintainability. Architecture and Integrations: Design and maintain application architecture, APIs, integrations, and data exchanges with internal systems, ensuring secure, reliable, and efficient data flows. Code Quality and Testing: Maintain automated testing, static analysis, code-quality checks, and code-review practices. Use tools such as Pest, PHPStan, Laravel Pint, and related technologies to uphold high engineering standards. CI/CD and Deployment Automation: Support and improve continuous integration and delivery pipelines using Jenkins, Git, and Gitea, streamlining releases and reducing manual operational effort. Technical Leadership: Conduct code reviews, provide technical guidance, share knowledge, and support other developers in solving complex engineering challenges. Application Incident Management: Lead application-level incident response, troubleshoot production issues, perform root-cause analysis, and implement corrective and preventive measures. Infrastructure and Systems Administration: Administer a high-availability Proxmox cluster and manage related technologies, including Ceph/CephFS, ZFS, Linux systems, and containerized services. Platform Operations: Maintain and support essential services, including PostgreSQL, Jenkins, Gitea, web servers, Icinga, Grafana, and Loki, ensuring availability and operational stability. Security, Backup, and Recovery: Support access management, system patching, security controls, backup processes, recovery procedures, and capacity planning to protect infrastructure and business continuity. Monitoring and Continuous Improvement: Respond to infrastructure incidents, improve monitoring and logging, automate repetitive tasks, optimize deployment processes, and contribute to service restoration and root-cause investigations. Documentation and Knowledge Sharing: Maintain clear technical documentation covering system architecture, configurations, operational procedures, recovery plans, and runbooks. Requirements Professional Experience: At least 8 years of professional experience in software development and related ICT domains, with a proven track record as a senior developer, technical lead, or equivalent technical specialist. PHP and Laravel Expertise: Strong hands-on experience developing and maintaining production applications using PHP and modern frameworks, ideally Laravel. Familiarity with PHP 8.4, Laravel 12, and Filament 5 is advantageous. Application Architecture and Databases: Strong understanding of application architecture, API design, system integrations, and relational databases, particularly PostgreSQL. Experience supporting business-critical, data-driven applications is essential. Software Quality and Security: Solid knowledge of secure coding practices, automated testing, static analysis, code reviews, and software quality standards. Experience with Pest, PHPUnit, PHPStan, and Laravel Pint is beneficial. CI/CD and Version Control: Practical experience with Git-based development workflows, Jenkins, continuous integration, continuous delivery, and deployment automation. Infrastructure and DevOps: Hands-on systems administration experience covering Linux, virtualization, containers, storage, monitoring, backups, security, and production infrastructure support. High-Availability Systems: Experience managing complex production environments, troubleshooting incidents, conducting root-cause analysis, and implementing reliable recovery and prevention strategies. Preferred Infrastructure Technologies: Experience with Proxmox, Ceph/CephFS, ZFS, Icinga, Grafana, Loki, and OVH-hosted infrastructure is strongly preferred. Familiarity with VMware, KVM, Prometheus, or comparable technologies is also valuable. Technical Documentation: Ability to produce clear, structured documentation and communicate technical knowledge effectively across teams. Communication and Collaboration: Ability to work independently, take ownership of technical decisions, and collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders. Professional proficiency in English is required. Education: A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience. Domain Knowledge: Experience with master data management, product information systems, supply chain platforms, or procurement systems is an additional advantage. Technology Environment: PHP 8.4, Laravel 12, Filament 5, PostgreSQL 15, Composer, Git, Gitea, Jenkins, PHPStan, Pest, Laravel Pint, Bruno, Sphinx, Doxygen, Proxmox HA, Ceph/CephFS, ZFS, Linux, containers, Icinga, Grafana, Loki, and OVH-hosted infrastructure. Application Note: Candidates should ensure their professional profile is complete and up to date and be prepared to provide concise, concrete examples of production work demonstrating both Laravel development and infrastructure administration experience. Relevant examples may include applications built or maintained, architecture decisions, testing and code-quality improvements, infrastructure and storage administration, monitoring and logging implementations, production incidents and their resolution, and backup or recovery procedures. Examples should describe your specific contribution, the production context or scale, and key technical decisions, rather than tutorials, personal experiments, or coursework. Benefits Fully Remote Work: Work remotely, with the opportunity to collaborate with distributed teams on real-world software projects. Technical Ownership: Take responsibility for business-critical applications and the infrastructure that supports them, with opportunities to influence architecture, engineering standards, and operational practices. Broad Technical Scope: Work across application development, databases, CI/CD, infrastructure, monitoring, security, and production reliability. Professional Growth: Expand your expertise across modern PHP and Laravel development, DevOps, high-availability systems, automation, and production operations. Collaborative Environment: Share knowledge with other technical professionals and contribute to improving development practices and system reliability. Flexible Remote Opportunities: Benefit from a remote-first working arrangement designed to support collaboration across distributed teams. Finans sektöründe faaliyet gösteren müşterimiz ile birlikte yürütmüş olduğumuz projelerimiz için Backend ve Entegrasyon Geliştirici olarak müşteri lokasyonundan ve uzaktan çalışabilecek enerjik ekip arkadaşları arıyoruz.
